WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
), regional_averages AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count,
           AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg
    FROM district_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count, region_avg
    FROM regional_averages
    WHERE account_count > region_avg
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(account_count) AS avg_account_count
    FROM above_average
), ranked AS (
    SELECT aa.district_id, aa.region, aa.account_count,
           aa.account_count - aa.region_avg AS excess,
           1.0 * aa.account_count / oa.avg_account_count AS ratio,
           RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY 1.0 * aa.account_count / oa.avg_account_count DESC
           ) AS ratio_rank
    FROM above_average AS aa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
)
SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE ratio_rank <= 10
ORDER BY ratio DESC;
